UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information stored upon authentication.

id.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

photoURL.description: URL to the user profile avatar picture.

UserSummary.title: UserSummary
UserSummary.description: A YouTube video intelligence summary saved by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier of the summary record.

userId.description: The UID of the owner who created this summary.

videoTitle.description: Title of the analyzed YouTube video.

videoChannel.description: Channel name of the YouTube video.

videoThumbnail.description: Thumbnail URL of the YouTube video.

tldr.description: The TL;DR overview of the video.

style.description: Style mode used (executive, technical, casual, etc.).

summaryData.description: Serialized JSON string of the complete StructuredSummary object.

isBookmarked.description: Whether this summary is bookmarked by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the summary was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document accessible only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/summaries/{summaryId}.description: Collection of video summaries saved by the authenticated user.
